symptom: ako/mxcli#841: widgets inside a layout `placeholder Main { … }` block skipped the check-time page validators. check passed and exec wrote a legacy quoted DynamicClasses ('if … then ''on'' else '''''') as its literal text with no MDL-WIDGET33, and a list view holding a text box was stored Editable false with no MDL-WIDGET31; the same widgets in the bare page body were refused / warned. Also silent there: MDL-WIDGET32, MPR010, MDL-BUTTON01, MDL-PAGE01, MDL-WIDGET11 (design properties), MDL-OFFLINE01 and the --references forward-page check.
cause: CreatePageStmtV3 keeps bare-body widgets in Widgets and placeholder content in Placeholders (#532). The builder writes both, but seven validators switched on the statement and walked s.Widgets only. #1149 had moved three --references validators onto allPageWidgets; the rest kept their own copy of the switch. Fix: documentWidgets(stmt) returns label + all roots (bare body and every placeholder) for page and snippet, and every page walker takes its roots from it.
file: mdl/executor/validate.go (allPageWidgets, documentWidgets), validate_widgets.go, validate_page_button_context.go, validate_page_layout.go, validate_design_properties.go, validate_page_order.go, validate_offline_paths.go, validate_widget_member_refs.go
insight: When an AST node holds the same kind of content in two fields, every walker that copies the type switch picks one field. This was the fourth miss of the same walk. Grep for `s.Widgets` on the statement type, and test parity rather than per rule: run ValidateProgram on the same body in three positions and require identical diagnostics, with the bare body reporting the rule as the control.
